investigation.title: Contoso — two independent issues after 2.1.0
investigation.escalationText: Contoso has two independent issues. First, VAT invoice totals have been blank since the 2.1.0 upgrade; the fix was promised for the Sep 20 release and the ticket was closed while the totals were still blank. Second, finance users cannot sign in since the identity migration; the SSO fix was promised for the Sep 26 release and still fails. Our chases on 22 and 23 September went unanswered. Explain what happened on each issue and when each will actually be fixed.
investigation.plan:
Two independent client-visible failures for Contoso on Orbit: a VAT invoice totals defect tracked in ORB-101 and an SSO sign-in failure tracked in ORB-140. Each has its own root-cause path, release commitment (Sep 20 vs Sep 26) and owner trail, so they are investigated separately. The shared thread to reconstruct is the client's unanswered chases on 22–23 September and how status transitions (Resolved/Reopened/closed) lined up with what the client actually saw in 2.1.3/2.1.4 and 3.4/3.4.1.

Issues in this escalation (2):
1. VAT invoice totals blank since 2.1.0 upgrade; early closure on 2.1.3 (ORB-101) — the client asks: Explain why VAT invoice totals were blank, why ORB-101 was closed as resolved in 2.1.3 while totals were still blank, and when the VAT fix will actually be delivered.
2. SSO sign-in failure for finance users after identity migration (ORB-140) — the client asks: Explain why finance users cannot sign in via SSO since the identity migration, why the promised Sep 26 SSO fix still fails, and when SSO will actually work.

Hypotheses to test:
- ORB-101 was resolved against 2.1.3 on an internal verification that did not reproduce the client's VAT invoice export path, so the blank-totals defect persisted past the Sep 20 release commitment. — test: Line up ORB-101 status changes (Resolved on 2024-09-21, Reopened 2024-09-26, Resolved 2024-09-28) against build references 2.1.3/2.1.4 and any evidence of how 'totals verified' was checked versus the client's finance sandbox export.; falsify: If there is a recorded client-side confirmation or a reproduced export showing non-blank totals in 2.1.3 before the Sep 21 resolution, the claim of premature/mis-scoped verification fails.
- The VAT blank-totals defect has a distinct root cause (e.g. a 2.1.0 change affecting invoice totals calculation, such as rounding or export formatting) that the Sep 20 release did not address. — test: Trace the 2.1.0-to-2.1.3/2.1.4 change path for invoice/VAT totals and exports; check whether any fix or release note in that window names VAT totals, rounding, or exports, and whether the blank behavior is reproducible on 2.1.4.; falsify: If a single documented change in 2.1.x demonstrably corrects blank VAT totals and the client still reports blanks only on an older build, the separate-root-cause hypothesis fails.
- ORB-140 was moved to Resolved on the 3.4.1 SSO fix (SAML certificate restored) without confirming the Contoso finance tenant actually completes SAML sign-in, so SSO still fails for the client. — test: Compare the 2024-09-26 In Progress→Resolved transition and the 2024-09-29 identity-service 3.4 / 3.4.1 SAML certificate note against the 2024-09-30 'Verified SSO with Contoso finance; closing' event; check whether verification used the Contoso finance tenant after the 3.4.1 deploy.; falsify: If there is a recorded successful Contoso finance SSO sign-in on 3.4.1 before the close, then premature closure is not the cause of the client's continued failure.
- The client's 22–23 September chases went unanswered because the two tickets were in a Resolved/transition state on the support channel and no owner was actively triaging client replies. — test: Inspect orbit-support messages and ticket comments around 2024-09-22 to 2024-09-24 for inbound client chases and any owner response or absence thereof; correlate with ORB-101/ORB-140 status at that time.; falsify: If there are recorded responses to the client's 22–23 September chases (in slack or jira comments), the unanswered-chase hypothesis fails.

Source plan:
- jira: Pull full ORB-101 and ORB-140 histories (all comments, status transitions, resolution reasons, fix versions, links) from creation to 2024-09-30; also scan ORB-150/ORB-160 in case they are related fix 
- slack: Read orbit-support history for 2024-09-02 to 2024-09-30, focusing on release commitments (Sep 20, Sep 26), the 22–23 September client chases, reopen/close chatter and the SSO root-cause note.
- email: Look for client-facing release commitments, chase threads and reopen/close notifications on 22–23 September if recorded; check whether any reply was drafted or sent.

Seed terms: vat, totals, blank, invoice, exports, rounding, 2.1.0, 2.1.3, 2.1.4, ORB-101, resolved, fixed, verified, sso, saml, identity, migration, certificate, 3.4, 3.4.1

People to look at: Maya Rao, Ravi Menon, Leo Park, Dana Okafor, Sam Ortiz

Focus window: 2024-09-02 → 2024-09-30

Unknowns to keep open:
- Whether the client's 22–23 September chases are recorded anywhere (email vs slack vs jira) and who, if anyone, owned a response.
- What 'totals verified on our side' for ORB-101 actually covered on 2.1.3 versus the client's finance sandbox export path.
- Whether ORB-150/ORB-160 are related to either issue (e.g. follow-up fixes) or unrelated Contoso/Orbit work.
- Which build (2.1.4 or later) the client is currently on for the VAT issue and whether blank totals persist there.
- Whether the 3.4.1 SSO fix was deployed to the Contoso finance tenant and whether the 2024-09-30 'verified' step re-tested real finance-user sign-in.
- Relationship between the identity migration and the 3.4 SAML certificate drop — whether migration rollout or the release is the true trigger.

claims.text: Ravi Menon promised (to the Contoso ticket on ORB-101) that the VAT fix was scheduled for the Sep 20 release; that release shipped as 2.1.3 but the client's finance sandbox still showed blank VAT totals on 2.1.3, so the commitment was not met.
claims.quote: We have scheduled the VAT fix for the Sep 20 release.

claims.text: Ravi Menon closed ORB-101 as Resolved in 2.1.3 on internal-only verification ('totals verified on our side') without reproducing the client's finance sandbox export path; Maya Rao reopened it five days later because the sandbox still showed blank VAT totals on 2.1.3, showing the verification was premature and mis-scoped.
claims.quote: Resolved in 2.1.3; totals verified on our side.

claims.text: Maya Rao identified on ORB-150 that the BILLING-V2 refactor moved VAT rounding to integer math in 2.1.0, dropping fractional cents and blanking the export totals, and that the change was still unreviewed — i.e. the defect was a separate rounding root cause that the 2.1.3 release did not address.
claims.quote: The BILLING-V2 refactor moved VAT rounding to integer math in 2.1.0, which drops fractional cents and blanks the export totals. That change is still unreviewed.

claims.text: Maya Rao reopened ORB-101 on 2024-09-26 because the finance sandbox still showed blank VAT totals on 2.1.3, contradicting the earlier Resolved status; the ticket was only re-resolved in 2.1.4 on 2024-09-28, which is the delivery date of the actual VAT fix.
claims.quote: Reopened: the finance sandbox still shows blank VAT totals on 2.1.3.

claims.text: Maya Rao recorded the VAT fix as delivered in 2.1.4, with the VAT rounding path corrected and exports verified with finance — the actual delivery milestone for the blank-totals defect, after the Sep 20/2.1.3 commitment failed.
claims.quote: Fixed in 2.1.4. The VAT rounding path was corrected; exports verified with finance.

claims.text: The VAT blank-totals defect was caused by the BILLING-V2 refactor moving VAT rounding to integer math in 2.1.0, which drops fractional cents and blanks the export totals; that change was never reviewed (ORB-150).
claims.quote: The BILLING-V2 refactor moved VAT rounding to integer math in 2.1.0, which drops fractional cents and blanks the export totals. That change is still unreviewed.

claims.text: Contoso reported that VAT invoice exports showed blank totals since the 2.1.0 upgrade, blocking finance reconciliation — the client-visible symptom of the rounding regression.
claims.quote: Since the 2.1.0 upgrade our VAT invoice exports show blank totals. Finance is blocked on reconciliation.

claims.text: VAT blank-totals root cause: the BILLING-V2 refactor moved VAT rounding to integer math in 2.1.0, dropping fractional cents and blanking export totals, and that change remains unreviewed (ORB-150).
claims.quote: The BILLING-V2 refactor moved VAT rounding to integer math in 2.1.0, which drops fractional cents and blanks the export totals. That change is still unreviewed.

claims.text: The VAT rounding regression had its own tracking ticket, ORB-150 (BILLING-V2: VAT rounding regression), opened by Ravi Menon on 2024-09-10 — separate from client ticket ORB-101 and never linked into the 2.1.3 resolution.
claims.quote: Issue created: BILLING-V2: VAT rounding regression

claims.text: Ravi Menon committed the VAT fix to the Sep 20 release on 2024-09-05, both on ORB-101 and on the orbit-support channel.
claims.quote: We have scheduled the VAT fix for the Sep 20 release.

claims.text: Ravi Menon resolved ORB-101 on 2024-09-21 stating 'totals verified on our side' for 2.1.3 — an internal-only verification, with no record of reproducing the client's finance sandbox export path.
claims.quote: Resolved in 2.1.3; totals verified on our side.

claims.text: Ravi Menon announced the ORB-101 closure on the support channel as 'the VAT fix is in 2.1.3', propagating the premature resolution to the client-facing channel.
claims.quote: Marking ORB-101 resolved; the VAT fix is in 2.1.3.

claims.text: Leo Park promised the client on ORB-140 that the SSO fix would ship in the Sep 26 release; when the ticket was resolved on 2024-09-26 the fix did not work — Dana Okafor reported the next day that SSO was still failing for finance — so the Sep 26 commitment was broken.
claims.quote: We will ship the SSO fix in the Sep 26 release.

claims.text: Leo Park closed ORB-140 as Resolved on 2024-09-26 on the basis that 'the identity migration is complete', which was not a verification of actual Contoso finance SAML sign-in; the root cause (SAML certificate dropped in the 3.4 migration) had not been fixed at that point.
claims.quote: Resolved; the identity migration is complete.

claims.text: Dana Okafor recorded on 2024-09-27 that SSO was still failing for finance and explicitly stated it was not fixed, one day after Leo Park resolved ORB-140 on the Sep 26 release.
claims.quote: Still failing for finance. This is not fixed.

claims.text: Sam Ortiz established the SSO root cause: the identity-service 3.4 migration dropped the SAML signing certificate from the tenant config, explaining why finance users could not sign in after the identity migration and why the Sep 26 fix failed.
claims.quote: The 3.4 migration dropped the SAML signing certificate from the tenant config; that is the SSO root cause.

claims.text: On ORB-140 Sam Ortiz recorded that the identity-service 3.4 migration dropped the SAML signing certificate as the cause of the SSO failure and that it was fixed in 3.4.1, moving the real fix beyond the promised Sep 26 release.
claims.quote: The identity-service 3.4 migration dropped the SAML signing certificate; that is why SSO fails. Fixed in 3.4.1.

claims.text: Maya Rao closed ORB-140 on 2024-09-30 stating SSO had been verified with Contoso finance after the 3.4.1 fix; the record contains no test detail showing a finance-user sign-in, so it cannot be confirmed that the 3.4.1 fix was deployed to the Contoso finance tenant and re-tested with a real finance user.
claims.quote: Verified SSO with Contoso finance; closing.

claims.text: Maya Rao reopened ORB-101 on 2024-09-26 because the client's finance sandbox still showed blank VAT totals on 2.1.3, confirming the Sep 20/2.1.3 fix did not resolve the defect.
claims.quote: Reopened: the finance sandbox still shows blank VAT totals on 2.1.3.

claims.text: The reopen was also announced on orbit-support by Maya Rao on 2024-09-26, publicly correcting the earlier 'fixed in 2.1.3' claim.
claims.quote: Reopened ORB-101: the finance sandbox still shows blank VAT totals on 2.1.3.

claims.text: The actual VAT fix landed in 2.1.4, with Maya Rao recording on 2024-09-28 that the VAT rounding path was corrected and exports verified with finance — the real delivery eight days after the Sep 20 commitment.
claims.quote: Fixed in 2.1.4. The VAT rounding path was corrected; exports verified with finance.

claims.text: Maya Rao confirmed on orbit-support on 2024-09-30 that the VAT fix is in 2.1.4 with exports verified with finance.
claims.quote: VAT fixed in 2.1.4; exports verified with finance.

claims.text: The client's original report (Dana Okafor, 2024-09-02) ties the blank totals to the 2.1.0 upgrade and states finance is blocked on reconciliation.
claims.quote: Since the 2.1.0 upgrade our VAT invoice exports show blank totals. Finance is blocked on reconciliation.

claims.text: Dana Okafor logged ORB-101 on 2024-09-02 as VAT invoice exports showing blank totals after the 2.1.0 upgrade, with finance blocked on reconciliation — the client-visible symptom that the 2.1.3 fix did not clear.
claims.quote: Issue created: VAT invoice exports show blank totals after 2.1.0

claims.text: Dana Okafor logged ORB-140 on 2024-09-18 as SSO login failing for Contoso finance users, the client-visible symptom of the identity-migration certificate drop.
claims.quote: Issue created: SSO login fails for Contoso finance users

claims.text: Leo Park announced on the orbit-support channel on 2024-09-26 that ORB-140 was being marked resolved because the SSO fix was included — the same day the ticket was resolved from In Progress and one day before Dana Okafor reported the failure persisted.
claims.quote: Marking ORB-140 resolved; the SSO fix is included.

claims.text: Ravi Menon announced on the orbit-support channel on 2024-09-21 that ORB-101 was being marked resolved because the VAT fix was in 2.1.3, on the same basis as the internal ticket resolution that the client's sandbox later disproved.
claims.quote: Marking ORB-101 resolved; the VAT fix is in 2.1.3.

events.text: Maya Rao identified on ORB-150 that the BILLING-V2 refactor moved VAT rounding to integer math in 2.1.0, dropping fractional cents and blanking the export totals, and that the change was still unreviewed — i.e. the defect was a separate rounding root cause that the 2.1.3 release did not address.

events.headline: The VAT blank-totals defect was caused by the BILLING-V2 refactor…
events.text: The VAT blank-totals defect was caused by the BILLING-V2 refactor moving VAT rounding to integer math in 2.1.0, which drops fractional cents and blanks the export totals; that change was never reviewed (ORB-150).

events.headline: VAT blank-totals root cause: the BILLING-V2 refactor moved VAT rounding…
events.text: VAT blank-totals root cause: the BILLING-V2 refactor moved VAT rounding to integer math in 2.1.0, dropping fractional cents and blanking export totals, and that change remains unreviewed (ORB-150).

events.headline: Leo Park closed ORB-140 as Resolved on 2024-09-26 on the…
events.text: Leo Park closed ORB-140 as Resolved on 2024-09-26 on the basis that 'the identity migration is complete', which was not a verification of actual Contoso finance SAML sign-in; the root cause (SAML certificate dropped in the 3.4 migration) had not been fixed at that point.

events.headline: Maya Rao reopened ORB-101 on 2024-09-26 because the finance sandbox…
events.text: Maya Rao reopened ORB-101 on 2024-09-26 because the finance sandbox still showed blank VAT totals on 2.1.3, contradicting the earlier Resolved status; the ticket was only re-resolved in 2.1.4 on 2024-09-28, which is the delivery date of the actual VAT fix.

events.headline: Maya Rao reopened ORB-101 on 2024-09-26 because the client's finance…
events.text: Maya Rao reopened ORB-101 on 2024-09-26 because the client's finance sandbox still showed blank VAT totals on 2.1.3, confirming the Sep 20/2.1.3 fix did not resolve the defect.

events.headline: The reopen was also announced on orbit-support by Maya Rao…
events.text: The reopen was also announced on orbit-support by Maya Rao on 2024-09-26, publicly correcting the earlier 'fixed in 2.1.3' claim.

events.headline: Leo Park announced on the orbit-support channel on 2024-09-26 that…
events.text: Leo Park announced on the orbit-support channel on 2024-09-26 that ORB-140 was being marked resolved because the SSO fix was included — the same day the ticket was resolved from In Progress and one day before Dana Okafor reported the failure persisted.

events.headline: Dana Okafor recorded on 2024-09-27 that SSO was still failing…
events.text: Dana Okafor recorded on 2024-09-27 that SSO was still failing for finance and explicitly stated it was not fixed, one day after Leo Park resolved ORB-140 on the Sep 26 release.

events.headline: Maya Rao recorded the VAT fix as delivered in 2.1.4,…
events.text: Maya Rao recorded the VAT fix as delivered in 2.1.4, with the VAT rounding path corrected and exports verified with finance — the actual delivery milestone for the blank-totals defect, after the Sep 20/2.1.3 commitment failed.

events.headline: The actual VAT fix landed in 2.1.4, with Maya Rao…
events.text: The actual VAT fix landed in 2.1.4, with Maya Rao recording on 2024-09-28 that the VAT rounding path was corrected and exports verified with finance — the real delivery eight days after the Sep 20 commitment.

events.headline: On ORB-140 Sam Ortiz recorded that the identity-service 3.4 migration…
events.text: On ORB-140 Sam Ortiz recorded that the identity-service 3.4 migration dropped the SAML signing certificate as the cause of the SSO failure and that it was fixed in 3.4.1, moving the real fix beyond the promised Sep 26 release.

events.headline: Sam Ortiz established the SSO root cause: the identity-service 3.4…
events.text: Sam Ortiz established the SSO root cause: the identity-service 3.4 migration dropped the SAML signing certificate from the tenant config, explaining why finance users could not sign in after the identity migration and why the Sep 26 fix failed.

events.headline: Maya Rao confirmed on orbit-support on 2024-09-30 that the VAT…
events.text: Maya Rao confirmed on orbit-support on 2024-09-30 that the VAT fix is in 2.1.4 with exports verified with finance.

events.headline: Maya Rao closed ORB-140 on 2024-09-30 stating SSO had been…
events.text: Maya Rao closed ORB-140 on 2024-09-30 stating SSO had been verified with Contoso finance after the 3.4.1 fix; the record contains no test detail showing a finance-user sign-in, so it cannot be confirmed that the 3.4.1 fix was deployed to the Contoso finance tenant and re-tested with a real finance user.
